# Reliability Checklist: Generic Product-Line Seeder

**Purpose**: Validate reliability requirement quality for Generic Product-Line Seeder operator runbooks, CI evidence, apply-twice determinism, verify drift detection, compatibility wrapper behavior, and rollback-by-no-op expectations.
**Created**: 2026-05-22
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Stable Operator And CI Evidence

- [x] CHK001 Are preflight, apply, and verify evidence requirements explicit enough for operator runbooks and CI to consume the same stable JSON result envelope? [Completeness, Spec §US2, §FR-015, Contract §CLI Result Envelope]
- [x] CHK002 Are mode-specific statuses, codes, mutation statuses, action fields, and exit codes measurable for success, refusal, validation failure, contract-not-ready, verify drift, and CLI usage failures? [Measurability, Spec §FR-015, Contract §Required Statuses]
- [x] CHK003 Are evidence redaction requirements reliable enough that CI output and runbook transcripts can be retained without emitting credentials, tokens, passwords, raw logs, raw untrusted payloads, raw operator-evidence payloads, or matched secret substrings? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016, Constitution §XIII]
- [x] CHK004 Are snapshot hash and per-surface count requirements specific enough to remain stable across repeated local runs and across CI targets with equivalent seed state? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017, Contract §Snapshot Format]
- [x] CHK005 Are unavailable or absent target surfaces handled deterministically instead of being silently omitted from evidence? [Coverage, Contract §Snapshot Format]

## Apply-Twice Determinism

- [x] CHK006 Are apply-twice requirements measurable for no duplicate config-owned product-line, department, assignment, workflow, governance, or feature-flag records? [Measurability, Spec §US3-AC2, §SC-004]
- [x] CHK007 Are existing-target apply requirements clear that `--allow-existing` updates only reviewed config-owned fields while preserving unrelated operational and history state? [Consistency, Spec §FR-019, §FR-020]
- [x] CHK008 Are requirements complete for proving stable before/after snapshots and identity hashes during second apply with `--allow-existing`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017, §FR-022, §RR-003]
- [x] CHK009 Are repeated or interrupted apply edge cases covered with requirements that prevent duplicate config-owned rows and preserve non-owned state? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, §SC-004, §SC-009]
- [x] CHK010 Are project ticket counters, assignment timestamps, workflow use counters, task lineage, GitHub linkage, and unrelated feature flags explicitly included in preserved-state reliability evidence? [Completeness, Spec §FR-020, §SC-007]

## Verify-Mode Drift Detection

- [x] CHK011 Are verify-mode requirements unambiguous that matching and drifted target checks are read-only and do not require `--allow-existing`? [Clarity, Spec §FR-021, §SC-010]
- [x] CHK012 Are drifted-target requirements measurable through `VERIFY_DRIFT_DETECTED`, `verification_failed`, exit code 4, observed target evidence, and no-write proof? [Measurability, Quickstart §Verify, Contract §Exit Codes]
- [x] CHK013 Are config-owned surfaces and preserved non-owned surfaces both included in verify/no-mutation evidence so reliability regressions cannot hide behind partial comparisons? [Coverage, Spec §FR-017, §FR-020, Contract §Snapshot Format]
- [x] CHK014 Are validation, preflight, and verify failure requirements consistent that failures return structured evidence without opening a write transaction or mutating target state? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, §FR-021, Plan §Technical Context]

## Compatibility Wrapper Reliability

- [x] CHK015 Are compatibility wrapper requirements clear that `seed:mission-control` delegates to the canonical Mission Control config and the same generic existing-target policy? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, §FR-023]
- [x] CHK016 Are wrapper parity requirements measurable for preflight, apply, verify, existing-target refusal, apply-twice idempotency, and evidence categories? [Measurability, Spec §US3-AC3, §SC-011, Quickstart §Compatibility Wrapper]
- [x] CHK017 Are wrapper requirements consistent with generic-seeder requirements that prohibit hardcoded Mission Control workflow names, product-line identities, agent names, and repository assumptions in the generic path? [Consistency, Spec §FR-024, §FR-028]
- [x] CHK018 Are compatibility wrapper side-effect exclusions complete enough to prevent GitHub mutation, task creation, dispatch, claim, runner launch, sandbox creation, harness adapter creation, auto-merge, or SpecKit setup/autopilot invocation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-026, Quickstart §Static Scope Guards]

## Rollback And No-Op Recovery

- [x] CHK019 Are rollback-by-no-op expectations specified in operator-facing requirements, including the fact that there is no migration rollback, rollback is achieved by not running the explicit seed command, and failed validation/refusal/verify paths produce no mutations? [Coverage, Spec §FR-030, §SC-014, Quickstart §Rollback And No-Op Recovery]
- [x] CHK020 Are no-migration expectations consistent with the additive migration policy and the plan's no-migration decision? [Consistency, Constitution §VII, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK021 Are failed invalid-config and blocked-preflight no-mutation proofs sufficient for rollback-by-no-op review evidence? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017, §SC-007]
- [x] CHK022 Are residue-blocking requirements reliable enough that cleanup remains an operator decision and the seeder never deletes, unlinks, or automatically repairs target state? [Consistency, Spec §FR-027, Spec §US4-AC5]

## Scope Reliability

- [x] CHK023 Are Product Line B, GitHub mutation, autonomous work, runner, sandbox, harness adapter, auto-merge, and SpecKit setup/autopilot exclusions testable through grep/static evidence and review packet requirements? [Measurability, Spec §FR-025, §FR-026, §SC-012, §RR-004]
- [x] CHK024 Are future product-line reuse requirements bounded to config/schema reuse without requiring product-line-specific code edits or SPEC-010A live enablement? [Scope, Spec §US5, §FR-028, §SC-013]

## Notes

- Initial checklist generation found one reliability gap: rollback-by-no-op expectations were present in the implementation plan review-packet notes but not yet stated as operator-facing specification requirements.
- Remediation added Spec §FR-030, §SC-014, and Quickstart §Rollback And No-Op Recovery to make the no-migration rollback boundary, explicit-command no-op behavior, `not_mutated` failure/refusal/verify evidence, and manual backup-restore or reviewed re-apply recovery path reviewable.

- [x] CHK026 Does the reliability checklist now cover rollback-by-no-op and recovery expectations through operator-facing specification and quickstart evidence without adding migration, Product Line B, GitHub mutation, dispatch, runner, sandbox, or SpecKit invocation scope?
